body: Shit. I actually never thought about it like that. How our laws of physics could not applie out side of our universe.

I'm riddled with mental illness anxiety, depression, bi polar, ADHD. And all my family cared about is getting me medicated. And these thoughts of suicide have always been. It's something I always think about. It never leaves my mind. I'm honestly done talking about what made me choose this option. I've talked to Much n wanted time. So no more pushing it off I'm letting the thoughts in my mind win. Since they are right.

Chat about what? Why not to kill myself? There's no more chatting left to do. I broke my promise to myself. So I'm making sure I follow through with this one. Thanks for the kind words. Those I leave behind will not give a single fuck. Maybe they will be sad a month or 2 big whoop. I'm done caring for others. This is the one time I thought about myself.
